name: dewilkinson
description: Private Claude Code plugins for Dave Wilkinson's private builds

plugins.name: splatlab-dev
plugins.description: Role pipeline for the private SplatLab build (the private surfels checkout): /requirements and /architect skills that interview the user and write docs, and coder / tester / reviewer subagents that implement, verify, and review against those docs.

plugins.name: cauldron-dev
plugins.description: Tooling for AMD Cauldron DX12 projects. /new-cauldron-project scaffolds an empty, buildable Cauldron application (root CMakeLists, CMakeSettings, src/DX12 app + renderer skeleton, Cauldron submodule cloned from a local checkout, prebuilt Cauldron libraries) and generates its Visual Studio solution.
